title: Corrigendum to &quot;Evaluation of black carbon estimations in global aerosol models&quot; published in Atmos. Chem. Phys., 9, 9001-9026, 2009
problem: Global aerosol models exhibit large discrepancies in their estimations of black carbon concentrations, leading to significant uncertainties in climate impact assessments and requiring systematic evaluation against observational data.
method: This paper evaluates global aerosol models by comparing their simulated vertical profiles of black carbon against in-situ aircraft measurements from various field campaigns to assess model performance and identify discrepancies.
task: This paper evaluates the performance of multiple global aerosol models by comparing their simulated vertical profiles of black carbon concentration against in-situ data gathered from various aircraft-based field campaigns.
innovation: This corrigendum provides corrected figures for a 2009 multi-model evaluation that compared simulated black carbon aerosol profiles against extensive aircraft measurements from several field campaigns to assess model performance.
